name: 38801 · Tupelo, MS
findings: ZIP 38801 (Tupelo) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38801 (Tupelo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
